milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because stone slabs drop themselves as items when mined with a pickaxe. The player starts with 0 stone_slabs in inventory (verified via sandbox inventory screenshot), so having ≥1 confirms the player successfully mined a stone_slab block. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted stone_axe ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 stone_axes (verified via sandbox inventory screenshot), so having ≥1 confirms successful crafting. The recipe requires 3 cobblestone (available in the adjacent chest) + 2 sticks (in starting inventory), crafted at the crafting table placed at (~-3,0,4). This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
